substeps.caption: Tray E at the opening: 3 Pi 5 units, each on a 2020 post with a sliding block and a pan-tilt head, aimed at an instrument's working face; the highest stands 680 mm over the tray floor. They stand in front of or beside their instruments and look back, away from the opening. The overhead unit sits on a bar at the back of the bay, 11 mm over Kardex's product envelope and 12 mm under the tray stored above the opening.
